author: jirachijon
quote: This is to counter the very obviously bought review scores from critics, and if it's not obvious, pay better attention and work on your critical thinking skills. The real score for the game is probably somewhere around 8-8.5, which is not objectively terrible, but for how much hype, budget, and development time were put into it, it's pretty pathetic. Definitely not the AAAA release we were promised, and DEFINITELY not a 99/100. Lmfao
